types.description: The object types a row may have (a product parameter, R-84); the first is the type of a sighting whose `kind` is not one of them.

promote_after.description: How many distinct turns make a candidate row active (the owner's `object_confirm` makes it active at once).

description.purpose: The ONE writer of the objects hive: a `thing_seen` sighting counts for the row whose alias it names and whose round covers the sighting's round (or starts a candidate row of its own), a tool change from `./tools` (`edit`) writes a field. Every change is a new row `rev + 1` with `supersedes`; nothing is updated or deleted, and the unique index (id, rev) is the compare-and-set.
description.use_when: Inside an objects hive only, behind `thing_seen` and `edit`.
description.not_in_scope: No owner decision (`./tools`), no brief, no push, no read for a model.
description.emits_meaning: `gate_store` to `./store`, `answer` to `./tools` (under `caller` 'tools'), `changed` to `./push` with the new row when its head is active or an active row was retired.
description.consumes_meaning: A sighting, a change request, and the store's answers to its own bundles.
